model-value.desc: Model of the component; use v-model directive

type.desc: Input type (text, password, textarea, email, search, tel, file, number, url, time, date)

label.desc: A text label that will float above the input field

hide-hint.desc: Hide hint when field is not focused

shadow-text.desc: Shadow text displayed at the end of the input

stack-label.desc: Force the label to always be visible

label-color.desc: Label color from the Quasar Color Palette

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

bg-color.desc: Background color from the Quasar Color Palette

clearable.desc: Appends clearable icon when a value is set

counter.desc: Show a character counter at the bottom

maxlength.desc: Specify a max length of model

autogrow.desc: Make field autogrow along with its content (uses textarea)

autofocus.desc: Focus field on initial component render

loading.desc: Signals a process is in progress by displaying a spinner

prepend.desc: Prepend inner field; suggestion: QIcon, QBtn

append.desc: Append to inner field; suggestion: QIcon, QBtn

before.desc: Prepend outer field; suggestion: QIcon, QBtn

after.desc: Append outer field; suggestion: QIcon, QBtn

label.desc: Custom label; overrides the 'label' prop if used

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the model value changes

focus.desc: Emitted when the field receives focus

blur.desc: Emitted when the field loses focus

clear.desc: Emitted when the clearable icon is clicked
